meta.name: bug-hunt-swarm
meta.description: Parallel read-only multi-agent root-cause investigation for bugs, regressions, crashes, flaky behavior, or unexplained failures. Use when the user asks to investigate a bug, find the root cause, trace a regression, understand why something broke, or wants a ranked diagnosis with the fastest proof path without making code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 并行排查代码缺陷根因，给出最快验证路径
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速定位复杂bug的根因
copy.tagline_en: Investigate bug root causes in parallel with fastest proof path
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find root causes of complex bugs

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会并行派出四个只读子智能体调查 bug，然后汇总并排序最可能的原因，给出最快的验证或修复路径。整个过程不修改任何代码。
howto.when: 当你要求调查 bug、寻找根因、追踪回归、解释故障原因，或希望获得带排名的诊断且不修改代码时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个崩溃的根因是什么。
say.note: Claude 会启动四个子智能体并行调查。

say.text: 这个测试最近老是失败，帮我找找原因。
say.note: Claude 会检查最近的代码变更和测试环境。

say.text: 为什么这个功能突然不工作了？
say.note: Claude 会分析代码路径和回归可能性。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will launch four read-only sub-agents in parallel to investigate a bug, then synthesize and rank the most likely root causes, recommending the fastest path to prove or fix the issue. No code edits are made.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to investigate a bug, find root cause, trace a regression, understand why something broke, or request a ranked diagnosis without code edits.

say_en.text: Find the root cause of this crash.
say_en.note: Claude launches four sub-agents in parallel.

say_en.text: This test keeps failing recently, help me find why.
say_en.note: Claude checks recent changes and test environment.

say_en.text: Why did this feature suddenly stop working?
say_en.note: Claude analyzes code paths and regression possibilities.
